content.short: Rain is a corporate credit card.
content.description: Rain enables teams to spend their on-chain assets off-chain without needing to off-ramp funds or open a traditional bank account. In essence, Rain functions as a corporate credit card, giving organizations a familiar, card-based way to handle day-to-day expenses while keeping the underlying assets on-chain. This approach reduces friction between on-chain assets and off-chain purchases, offering a practical bridge for teams that want to spend with ease. It addresses enterprise spending needs by pairing the flexibility of on-chain assets with the convenience of a corporate card.
